reason: PURE. The first thing I noticed was "Every batch lab-tested" with the QR code, because that is the only thing that makes me less of a skeptic. I would scan it before paying, and if the report is real I would try one box, but only the single-form one since it is simpler and I do not trust a 3-form blend to be more than marketing.
objection: Most supplements are marketing, and $29.99 is a lot on my budget for something I cannot feel working. Two capsules a day is also a lot to swallow, and I would have to carry sachets when I travel.
would_change_my_mind: A batch report I can open before buying that shows the magnesium content matches the label, or a lower price or smaller trial pack so I do not risk a full month.
